data.name: Empire Together
data.detailed_description:
Build a business empire. Solo or with friends.

Start from nothing and build the commercial empire of your dreams. Empire Together is a management tycoon where you launch, run, and grow multiple types of businesses within a single living city. Corner shop, restaurant, salon, workshop, every business has its own rules, its own customers, and its own opportunities. It's up to you to build the most profitable portfolio.

🏢 Diversify your businesses

Don't limit yourself to a single shop. Open a convenience store, then a restaurant, then a specialty service, each type of business has its own management mechanics, its own furniture, its own employee profiles, and its own target audience. Become a versatile mogul or specialize in one sector.

🏪 Design each location freely

Build mode lets you lay out the interior of every establishment piece by piece. Place counters, equipment, displays, and workstations to optimize customer flow and team productivity. Every layout shapes your results.

👥 Recruit a team for each business

Hire from a pool of candidates with diverse skills. Cashiers, stockers, specialists, assign the right person to the right role in the right business. A well-managed team is the difference between a shop that survives and an empire that dominates.

📦 A complete, connected economy

Track the performance of each of your businesses through the daily dashboard: revenue, costs, margins, customer satisfaction. Reinvest wisely, expand an existing shop, open a new location, or branch out into an untapped sector.

🌐 Play cooperatively

Empire Together is built for multiplayer from the ground up. Start a game and invite your friends to co-found your empire. Co-manage the same businesses, or split up the portfolio: one partner runs the grocery side, another grows the restaurants, a third heads off to explore a new market. Everything stays synced in real time.

🏙️ A city to conquer

Explore a stylized city where every location is an opportunity. Spot high-traffic zones, observe the clientele, pick the ideal spot for your next venture. The world doesn't stop at your storefront.

⭐ Key features

  • Multiple business types to unlock and run in parallel

  • Solo & online co-op for up to 8 players via Steam

  • Free build mode to design every establishment

  • Dynamic hiring system with a varied candidate pool

  • Multi-business economy: dashboard, margins, growth

  • Stylized open city to explore and scout your next locations

  • Steam Cloud saves to pick up your empire anywhere

From the little corner shop to the sprawling holding company, what kind of empire will you build?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (version 1909 or later)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 (2 GB) / AMD Radeon R9 280 / Intel Iris Xe
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 (6 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
